title: SMS Delivery Failures from Twilio to Telemat Cel Brazil
impact_summary: SMS delivery to Telemat Cel subscribers in Brazil is failing.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must act immediately to prevent loss of critical notification services.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe Martinique
impact_summary: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe network subscribers in Martinique. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.
backbase_rationale: The delays could impact timely message delivery for Backbase clients.

title: Update to SendGrid Domain Authentication: Send to Coworker Action Removed
impact_summary: The removal of the Send to Coworker action from the domain authentication flow simplifies setup and enhances security by discouraging email-based DNS updates.
backbase_rationale: To ensure reliable DNS configuration and reduce error risk, the action is no longer available.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.18.0
impact_summary: SDK now requires minSdkVersion 24, affecting older Android devices.
backbase_rationale: Backbase must ensure its applications support the new minimum SDK version to continue using the Jumio SDK.

title: Jumio Android SDK v4.14.0
impact_summary: SDK updated to comply with WCAG 2.2 AA and EAA accessibility standards.
backbase_rationale: Backbase should verify that its applications meet the updated accessibility requirements.

title: SMS Delivery Delays from Twilio to Free Caraibe France
impact_summary: SMS delivery to Free Caraibe subscribers in France is delayed.
backbase_rationale: Backbase monitors the situation to ensure no impact on user onboarding flows.
